boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Fondren Library study environments, from Rice-only quiet floors to reservable rooms and media-production spaces.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library Sixth-Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Sixth-Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • Rice ID required
cards.notes: Bring your Rice ID and choose a seat on the sixth floor when you need a designated quiet-study setting away from group-room activity.
cards.short_summary: A Rice-only quiet floor for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren’s current floor maps identify the sixth floor as a Rice-only quiet study space requiring a Rice ID.
cards.access_notes: Rice ID required; use during Fondren Library building hours.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library Second-Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Second-Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • Second floor
cards.notes: Settle near the second-floor quiet zone for a library work session, with general stacks and scanners shown on the current floor plan.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study beside second-floor stacks and scanning.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren’s current floor-plan PDF labels a Quiet Study Zone on the second floor and shows stacks and scanning there.
cards.access_notes: Use during Fondren Library building hours; consult the floor plan for location.

cards.title: Study Room 156
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • reservable large study room
cards.notes: Reserve this larger room ahead when your project needs a contained workspace; keep the checkout key schedule in mind before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A large, reservable Fondren study room.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren lists Room 156 among its largest study rooms and allows it to be reserved more than three days in advance.
cards.access_notes: Active Rice NetID holders may reserve; reservations normally require key checkout and can be made three days ahead, with this room eligible earlier.

cards.title: Study Room 201
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • reservable large study room
cards.notes: Book Room 201 for a planned work block, then collect the key at the Service Desk and return it before the library closes.
cards.short_summary: A large study room with advance-reservation eligibility.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren lists Room 201 among its largest study rooms and allows it to be reserved more than three days in advance.
cards.access_notes: Active Rice NetID holders may reserve; study-room keys must be returned 15 minutes before library closing.

cards.title: Study Room 601
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • reservable large study room
cards.notes: Plan a substantial reading or project session in Room 601 by reserving first, then check in promptly so the booking is not released.
cards.short_summary: A sixth-floor large room for a reserved study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren lists Room 601 among its largest study rooms and allows it to be reserved more than three days in advance.
cards.access_notes: Active Rice NetID holders may reserve; unclaimed reservations are released after 30 minutes.

cards.title: Room 336 Listening Room
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • record player, DVD player, and keyboard
cards.notes: Reserve Room 336 when course work calls for listening or viewing; its record player, DVD player, and keyboard support media-centered sessions.
cards.short_summary: A reservable listening room with playback equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren identifies Room 336 as a listening room with a record player, DVD player, and keyboard; it is not soundproof.
cards.access_notes: Active Rice NetID holders may reserve; room is not soundproof and may be booked more than three days in advance.

cards.title: DMC Audio Studio B42D
cards.subtitle: Fondren basement • reservation required
cards.notes: Use this studio for an audio-based class project or research output; reserve ahead and check out the key from the DMC Service Desk.
cards.short_summary: A soundproofed audio-production studio for Rice affiliates.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren’s DMC policies designate Audio Studio B42D for Rice students, faculty, and staff, with reservations during DMC open hours.
cards.access_notes: Rice ID required; reserve up to 30 days ahead for up to four hours, during DMC open hours only.

cards.entity_name: DMC Video and Photography Studio B42E
cards.title: DMC Video & Photography Studio B42E
cards.subtitle: Fondren basement • reservation required
cards.notes: Reserve this studio for a visual assignment or project documentation, then check in at the DMC Service Desk to receive the key.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated visual-media workspace inside Fondren’s DMC.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren’s DMC policies designate Video/Photography Studio B42E for Rice students, faculty, and staff, with reservations during DMC open hours.
cards.access_notes: Rice ID required; reserve up to 30 days ahead for up to four hours, during DMC open hours only.

cards.title: Brown Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • third floor
cards.notes: Work alongside art, architecture, classical archaeology, and music materials; use the third-floor collection as a focused starting point for visual research.
cards.short_summary: A subject library built around fine-arts collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren identifies the Brown Fine Arts Library on its third floor and says its collection supports Rice fine arts departments.
cards.access_notes: Located on Fondren’s third floor; use during Fondren Library building hours.

cards.title: GIS/Data Center
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library • basement
cards.notes: Bring a mapping or spatial-data question to this basement center, where the library provides GIS software and data assistance for research work.
cards.short_summary: A basement workspace for GIS and spatial-data research.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren identifies its GIS/Data Center in the basement and states that it provides geographic information systems software and data assistance.
cards.access_notes: Located in Fondren’s basement; contact the center or consult library hours before a specialized GIS session.
